rule: A diamond is turned up as the prize and everyone bids one card from their own suit, face down and at the same time. The highest bid takes the prize's rank in points; a tie means nobody takes it. The only hidden thing is what you are bidding right now -- an opponent's remaining cards are simply their suit minus what they have spent. Thirteen rounds use up the prizes; the highest total wins.
